items.title: 14.16 Maashi, samaji aur siyasi masail (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.16 with its printed subsections, printed page 319.

blocks.text: Hawa ki aaloodgi aur kharab hawa ka mayar bhari maashi qeemat aur samaji aur siyasi masail ke zimmedar hain.

items: Kharab hawa bimari aur ghair-hazri se mazdoor ki paidawar ghatati hai.
Hawa ki aaloodgi faslon ko nuqsan de kar zarai paidawar ghatati aur khurak ki qeematein barhati hai.
Hawa ki aaloodgi se acid rain imarton, pulon aur doosre infrastructure ko kharab karti hai.
Kamzor aabadiyan jaise bachche, buzurg aur kam aamdani wali communities ghair-mutanasib taur par mutasir hoti hain.
Aaloodi hawa ka purana samna zindagi ka majmooi mayar ghatata hai, samaji bhalai aur community ki sehat par asar dalte hue.
Shadeed aaloodgi logon ko behtar hawa wale ilaqon ki taraf hijrat par majboor kar sakti hai, samaji be-dakhli aur mutalliqa masail paida karte hue.
Moassar hawa ke mayar ke zawabit nafiz karna siyasi aur maashi mafadat ki wajah se mushkil hai.
Hawa ki aaloodgi sarhadon tak mehdood nahi, to moassar intizam ke liye bain-ul-aqwami taawun chahiye.
Zabta sakht hukmrani mangta hai, jo sanati tarraqi aur maashi barhotri ko sust kar sakti aur siyasi tasadum ki taraf le ja sakti hai.
Hawa ki aaloodgi se nimatna kasir-jehati tareeqa mangta hai jo samaji-maashi aur technological pehluon mein tawazun rakhe.

blocks.prompt: Smog ke mausam mein bhattiyan band karne ke hukoomati mansoobe se uthne wale maashi, samaji aur siyasi masail ka tajziya karein.
blocks.explanation: Maashi taur par bhatti maalikan aur mazdoor aamdani khote hain aur tameer ki laagat barhti hai, hospital ke bills, zaya kaam ke dinon aur fasal ke nuqsan ki bachat ke muqable; samaji taur par ghareeb tareen mazdoor nuqsan uthate hain jabke ghareeb tareen muhalle sehat mein sab se zyada faida pate hain; siyasi taur par maalikan pabandi ke khilaf lobby karte hain, nifaz ko mazboot hukmrani chahiye, aur kyunke smog soobai aur qaumi sarhadon ke paar ur jati hai mansooba parosi ilaqon ke saath mil kar kaam karne par sab se behtar chalta hai.

items: Maashi: zaya paidawar, fasal ka nuqsan, infrastructure ka galna. Samaji: bachche, buzurg aur ghareeb sab se zyada mutasir; zindagi ka kam mayar; hijrat. Siyasi: mafadat zabte ke khilaf; aaloodgi sarhadein paar karti hai (bain-ul-aqwami taawun); hukmrani ke muqable barhotri; kasir-jehati tawazun zaroori.
